quotes.quote: Differentially expressed circular RNAs (circRNAs) were obtained using GEO2R, and the expression of hsa_circ_0004099 was verified using RT-PCR.
The human plasma circRNA gene assay was selected from the GEO database ( https://www . ncbi. nlm. nih. gov/), and platform files as well as a series of matrix files were downloaded.

G1.rationale: The principal result (differential expression of hsa_circ_0004099) is produced by a computational analysis (GEO2R) of public microarray data (GSE133768), which a third party can re-run.

quotes.quote: found that the expression of hsa_circ_0004099 was downregulated, while its log2FC absolute value (3.52) was the largest among the downregulated circRNAs.

G2.rationale: The paper explicitly states the log2FC absolute value (3.52) as the largest among downregulated circRNAs, making it a principal quantitative result.
